title: Elux Firerose 5000 Strawberry Banana 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Elux Firerose 5000 Strawberry Banana Nic Salt combines two classic flavours into one smooth, satisfying vape. Juicy, sun-ripened Strawberries bring a bright, fruity sweetness, while the Banana adds a mellow creaminess that rounds off the blend with a velvety finish. It’s a simple yet indulgent pairing that’s perfect for those who enjoy fruit flavours with a touch of richness. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Strawberry Banana Nic Salt provides rich flavour, a tactile yet comfortable throat hit and discreet vapour production. Ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, this e-liquid works brilliantly in pod kits, vape pens and other low-powered devices. Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salts offer a convenient way to enjoy well-known Elux flavours, and thrilling new profiles, using refillable vape kits, delivering satisfaction, value, and performance in every 10ml bottle.
